---
title: "Python labs"
---

Run these commands from the repository root with Python 3.11 or newer.

## A read-only tool contract

```bash
python -m labs.tool_contract
```

The four rows show a successful lookup, an argument type error, an absent record, and an unknown tool. Add a case with an unexpected argument and check that the tool rejects it before any lookup. In a real system, the same dispatch boundary is where you would check caller identity and access to the requested resource.

## The AutoResearch loop

```bash
python -m labs.autoresearch --budget 4
```

Rerun with budgets 0 and 2. Compare the winner, its validation score, and its final holdout score. Explain from the trial records why a failed proposal consumes budget without becoming the incumbent. See the [case study](../case-studies/autoresearch.qmd) for the full protocol.

```bash
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
```
